title: Mid-size active orders
prompt: Return the id and amount of all orders that are not cancelled and have an amount between 50 and 200 (inclusive).
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, amount REAL, status TEXT); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1,1,120.50,'completed'),(2,2,45.00,'cancelled'),(3,3,300.00,'completed'),(4,4,15.75,'pending'),(5,5,89.99,'completed'),(6,1,250.00,'cancelled'),(7,2,60.00,'pending');
reference_sql: SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' AND amount BETWEEN 50 AND 200;
